text_block_list.text: Narita Brian is selected to be Umamusume of the Year.
Past winners will also be at the award ceremony. It could be good to speak with such seasoned racers, but maybe it's still too early for her…
Should we look to rub shoulders with the strongest racers or not? This important decision will affect her future.
choice_data_list: You want to face off with the best, so let's attend!
Maybe it's a little too soon.

text_block_list.text: We decide to attend. Together, we head to the arena where the strongest gather!
We decide not to attend. She claims she is still just a competitor, so we fix our sights solely on helping her become a stronger runner.
